summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Kumara Hotspot ISP landing site. All 10 pytest backend tests pass (root, packages, coverage supported/unsupported/empty, subscription create/list/invalid/missing, contact create/list/invalid email). Frontend critical flows verified end-to-end on desktop + mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Hydration warning in console: <span> inside <option> in Subscribe.jsx package select. This is being introduced by the Emergent dev-overlay wrapper (x-ve-dynamic spans injected into option children at dev time). It is a dev-only warning and does not break functionality, but main agent should be aware. Production builds (without the dev overlay) will not include the wrapper spans.

Server.py uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() stored as a string. Sort('created_at', -1) works because ISO-8601 is lexicographically sortable, which is fine, but consider storing native datetime for indexing/range queries later.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' from env; for production, restrict to the actual frontend origin.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test created a few TEST_ prefixed Subscription and ContactMessage records via the public API; no admin endpoint to clean them, but they are isolated by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_kumara_api.py (pytest). Re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_kumara_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend uses bilingual i18n with localStorage key 'kumara_lang' (default 'id'). Packages, coverage, subscription, contact and FAQ flows are all functional. WhatsApp number 6281234567890 is a placeholder MOCKED value as documented. Newsletter form is local-only (no backend) — verified intentional. Testimonials are static client-side.
verified_flows: GET /api/packages returns 4 packages with correct schema (home-basic, home-pro, business-pro, dedicated-1g).
POST /api/coverage/check: 'Jakarta Selatan' -> available=true, install=3 days; 'Aceh' -> available=false; empty -> 400.
POST /api/subscriptions: valid payload returns id+created_at; invalid package_id -> 400; missing name -> 422. GET lists most-recent first.
POST /api/contact: stores message; GET lists; invalid email -> 422.
Landing page renders all sections; all required data-testids present.
Language switch ID<->EN updates hero title, nav labels, package features; persists to localStorage and survives reload.
Packages filter tabs work: All=4, Home=2, Business=1; IDR price formatting present.
Clicking 'Berlangganan' on package-subscribe-home-pro preselects 'home-pro' in subscribe form.
Coverage check UI shows success message for Jakarta Selatan and warn message for Aceh in current language.
Subscribe form submits, shows subscribe-success banner, name input clears.
Floating WhatsApp + contact WA CTA both link to https://wa.me/6281234567890?text=... (URL-encoded prefilled message).
Mobile menu toggle opens menu with all nav links, language switch and subscribe CTA on 390x844 viewport.
